notes.title: Jeff’s Chill Disciples Have Arrived
notes.content: [p][b]Jeff’s Chill Disciples[/b] have entered the fight. [/p][p]This frosty faction bends the battlefield with ice themed abilities that can slow, freeze, and reshape the flow of combat. [/p][p]Whether locking down opponents or creating slippery escapes, their chill style adds a new layer of strategy to ExpressLane.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42622344/a2e12d22b2eeff236c46cece2d41a3f5d27e20d9.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Rise of Goosifer
notes.content: [p][b]Goosifer has entered the world of ExpressLane.[/b] [/p][p]A twisted faction marked by dark feathers and whispered omens, their followers pledge themselves to chaos and corruption.[/p][p]They wield strange rites and uncanny power, turning every encounter into a battle of faith and fear. [/p][p]Those who dare cross paths with Goosifer will find themselves caught between the lure of forbidden strength and the threat of utter ruin. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42622344/e65ac222268e14eb9de48d062f3c9db0f5df6945.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Children of the Sunken Star Rise
notes.content: [p]The Children of the Sunken Star are here. [/p][p]A mysterious faction that inhabits the desert, born from the ruins of lost caravans and the whispers of buried relics.[/p][p] Bound by superstition and scavenged technology, they fight with eerie devotion and strike from the dunes where others fear to tread. [/p][p]Their presence shifts the balance of ExpressLane’s world, offering new threats, strange alliances, and fresh opportunities for players bold enough to cross paths with them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42622344/51f69296ba3c2b5ef93b7c656295c6cc952b01a4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Artwork by our 2D art intern, Aki Zhang.[/p]

notes.title: Perkies Arrive: Power Up Your Play
notes.content: [p]The [b]Perkies system[/b] has landed in ExpressLane! [/p][p]Pick your power-up, bend the rules of movement, and outsmart anyone in your path. Whether you’re bouncing, dashing, or hauling more loot than you should, Perkies let you craft a playstyle that’s unmistakably yours. [/p][p]This is just the start: experiment, combine, and discover which ones turn the tide in your runs.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42622344/a842f4c8c794be9236e35e79ef7cb092edf88624.png"][/img][/p][p]Artwork by our 2D art intern, Aki Zhang.[/p]

notes.title: State of the Game 6/5/2025
notes.content:
[p]We're moving, and we're moving fast. Since the last update, we have added in weapons, weapon firing, animations, more movement, AI geese, and working on optimizing the map files.

Currently, we are perfecting the ADS and bloom mechanics. This comes with more animations, which is what takes the longest to get right. We want movement and animations to be as fluid as possible for the players.[/p][p][/p][p]Along with those changes, we are implementing AI attacking so the PvE can be as fun as possible. 

We gave our patrons early access to the build that we are pushing all of these updates on to get hands-on feedback from outside of the team. 

The team is open to all suggestions and ideas you may have conjured up from our social media posts so come join the [url="https://discord.gg/RBKsMzcetN"]Discord[/url]!

Thank you for the continued support,

ExpressLane Team

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42622344/e7be60118ac445552cfbe14a34cf5ff012559689.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: State of the Game 5/24/2025
notes.content:
Alright, it’s happening. We’re aiming to drop the ExpressLane playtest in about a month.

We’ve been rebuilding everything in Unreal Engine 5 to clean things up, kill some bugs, and make sure the game runs way smoother. It’s been a bit of a reset, but it’s already paying off.

From now on, we’ll be posting progress more often so you can see things come together.

Movement is back up and running, and we just started bringing 3D assets and islands into the new build. Below is a quick screenshot from today. 

We appreciate all of the support that we have been receiving recently and feedback and questions are always welcome!

We are open to discussion in our discord which you can join [url=https://discord.gg/RBKsMzcetN]here[/url].

More soon to come,

ExpressLane Team
